summary: Export bounded mission wait gauges, visible unknown-clock counts, and terminal-outcome lead-time histograms

replay.detail: Metrics never backfill or alter claim history.

schema.detail: Reads existing work and current-attempt clock projections; no additional schema or migration.

compatibility.detail: Additive OTLP instruments only; lifecycle, client, peer and harness protocols remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond a normal daemon upgrade.

manual.detail: Use max for replicated wait gauges and sum of per-node bucket rates for owner-emitted lead-time histograms. Unknown-clock counts guard incomplete waits.

recovery.detail: No persistent metric state; process restarts establish a fresh completion frontier without replaying past runs.
